q: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the ____. (P1)
explain: Genesis 1:1 records God as the Supreme Creator of the universe.

q: God placed the first man, Adam, in the Garden of ____. (P1)
explain: Adam was placed in Eden to cultivate and preserve it.

q: The mother of Jesus Christ was the Virgin ____. (P1)
explain: Mary was chosen to bear Jesus by the Holy Spirit.

q: Jesus was born in the town of ____ in Judea. (P1)
explain: Jesus was born in Bethlehem as prophesied in Micah 5:2.

explain: Genesis is the first book of the Holy Bible containing creation accounts.

explain: Revelation is the final apocalyptic book of the New Testament.
